A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same TikZilla/DaTikZ-V4 study. All 33 pages, including equations, figures, tables, references and appendices, are readable and can be matched reliably across versions.

before.justification: V1 reports original caption analysis, model benchmarks, human evaluations, ablations and debugging experiments, including Figure 4 and Tables 3–6 and 8–9.

after.justification: V3 retains these original experimental results in the main text and appendices, including model performance, human ratings and component ablations.

M1.justification: The dataset construction and two-stage SFT/GRPO method are unchanged. Section 5 retains the same inverse-graphics image encoder, Earth Mover’s Distance reward, format reward and RL modifications.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same DaTikZ-V3 caption-analysis samples, DaTikZ-V4 and DaTikZ-V4-RL training/evaluation coverage, and SPIQA out-of-distribution evaluation. No dataset, task or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within the main benchmark, SPIQA evaluation, reward ablations and caption/debugging comparisons. GPT-5, GPT-4o, Qwen variants, TikZero-Plus-10B and Llama3.1-8B retain their corresponding roles.

E3.justification: The 1,047-sample DaTikZ test set, 397 SPIQA cases, GPT-5 evaluation subset, decoding settings, training budgets and human-evaluation procedures remain unchanged. Adding downward arrows to average-token headers clarifies an existing metric without changing its computation or evaluation protocol.

E4.justification: Both retain the same input-quality, debugging, reward-model, dataset-scale and data-source ablations, SPIQA robustness evaluation, and appendix failure analyses and code examples. No analytical question or supporting experiment is added or removed.

E5.justification: Figure 4 retains the same 95% confidence intervals, and the annotator-agreement statistics and reporting procedures remain unchanged. There is no added or revised seed, repeated-run or significance-test information.

E6.justification: Numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged throughout both PDFs. For example, Table 3 retains AVG scores of 0.385 for TikZilla-3B-RL, 0.384 for TikZilla-8B-RL and 0.365 for GPT-5. Added highlighting emphasizes existing numerical rankings.

T1.justification: The SFT loss, GRPO objective, advantage expressions, reward definition and transport constraints in Section 5 are unchanged. No formal assumption, derivation, theorem or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: Both retain the same scientific contributions: the expanded TikZ dataset, domain-specific reward model and small Qwen-based models. Claims of outperforming GPT-4o and matching GPT-5 in human image-alignment evaluation are unchanged.

C2.justification: The interpretations of syntax grounding, shorter RL-generated code and text-versus-image ratings remain unchanged. Section 8 and Appendix A.5 retain the same VLM-description limitations, failure conditions and applicability discussion.

D1.justification: The abstract replaces a promise that code, data and models will become available with stated current availability and direct Hugging Face and GitHub links. This adds concrete access information; implementation details, hyperparameters and hardware disclosures are unchanged. Resource usability cannot be verified from the PDFs alone.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive positioning relative to prior research are unchanged. Citation wording, bibliography formatting and an equivalent localized URL spelling change without adding or removing research references.

P1.justification: The opening paragraph is lightly rewritten to foreground LLMs instead of NLP generally. Other edits remove the affiliation abbreviation, correct arXiv capitalization and standardize citation and bibliography wording. Section and appendix organization is retained.

P2.justification: V3 adds downward arrows to AT headers in Tables 3–6 and 9, expands bold/underline ranking emphasis in several tables and Figure 1, colors links blue, and adds resource icons. Minor first-page reflow accompanies these edits; scientific figures and table contents are retained.

improvement.justification: V3 improves access documentation by supplying explicit resource links where v1 promised future availability. Clearer metric-direction labels and ranking emphasis also improve readability. These are limited, supported gains; the scientific methods, evidence and limitations remain unchanged.
